description: This file defines the BracketPair class which encapsulates the concept of a pair of brackets, including common types like parentheses, square brackets, braces, and angle brackets. It provides methods to retrieve the open and close characters and a string representation of the pair.

classes.name: BracketPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of brackets, including open and close characters, with predefined constants for common bracket types.

methods.name: BracketPair
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bracket pair with open and close characters.

methods.name: getOpen
methods.description: Returns the open bracket character as a string.

methods.name: getClose
methods.description: Returns the close bracket character as a string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string concatenation of open and close characters.
